confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Foz do Iguaçu price indexes. The price indexes disagree widely and are partly crowdsourced. Some of their figures look too low for a tourist city. Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates, set above the lowest index figures to reflect tourist-area pricing. No search returned a cocktail price, so I set cocktail at about 3x beer and wine by the glass at about 2.5x beer, based on the usual local relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Foz do Iguaçu is a major tourist destination, and prices may be higher in peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against Brazilian mid-sized tourist cities such as Curitiba and other southern Brazil destinations. Foz do Iguaçu is roughly at or slightly below the national average on restaurant prices, based on the index data returned.
